ASK 03: root causes. (1) 54 golden subtests: bisect shows golden passes at 2602f80, fails at 5adfc45 whose only change is `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` version bump to 0.5.0; compose header line `plugin: 0.5.0 unpinned` embeds the version, golden was hashed with the old one. Not a rules change. Fix: normalise() in test_qab_optional.py masks the `plugin: <ver> ` token so no future bump breaks it (every other byte still hashed; golden.json unchanged). Alt: regenerate golden (breaks on each bump) — I recommend the mask. (2) test_no_pyc: stray bin/__pycache__ comes from running python without -B (not from the suite: run_suite.py sets PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1); removed, test passes on a clean tree with -B and without. No code change needed; I'll also check which test file in the suite writes bytecode when run by the runner. Touched files: tests/test_qab_optional.py, evidence.md/ticket in .scratch/squad-close-keeps-manager/issues/03-*. Proceeding on the mask unless you object.
